# Every field a live issue can carry

Open, assigned, blocked, labelled, and holding a frontmatter key the tool has
never written — `reviewer:`, put there by hand. Unknown keys are preserved on
rewrite, so this file fails the round trip the day that stops being true.

- a list item, which `clean_set` refuses inside a *value* and the body allows
- a second one, with a trailing space after it   

---

## Nothing below the fold is decoration

Every line here is a thing the parser has to hand back unchanged. Non-ASCII
lives in the body as well as the title: ü, ß, 中文, and an em dash — like that.

> A blockquote at the very bottom, because the last line of a body is where a
> `.strip()` in the wrong place shows up first.

```
--- a fence containing the frontmatter marker, which is neither
```
